sections.title: Valuation Insights
sections.text: Costco delivers a modest operating margin [[COST.ratio.operating_margin]] and an impressive return on average equity [[COST.ratio.return_on_average_equity]], while maintaining a low debt‑to‑equity ratio [[COST.ratio.debt_to_equity]]. The free cash flow [[COST.ratio.free_cash_flow]] supports dividend sustainability and potential share repurchases. However, the price‑earnings multiple [[COST.ratio.price_earnings]] is elevated relative to peers, suggesting the market is pricing in the strong revenue growth [[COST.ratio.revenue_growth]] and high EPS [[COST.fact.diluted_eps]].

insight.text: The combined long‑term and current debt represents a small fraction of equity, underscoring financial flexibility.
